bundle.longDescription: Prollyglot turns desktop audio into local live subtitles with a customizable overlay and optional local translation. The experimental Ubuntu build captures a playback output or application audio, and translates visible text from a portal-selected window, monitor, or drawn region. Translations use verified X11/XWayland anchors where available, with a movable reader as fallback. Speech, OCR, and translation models are installed explicitly in the app.
